verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live root llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a very large llms-full.txt (~2 MB of complete docs). Per-section llms.txt files exist for the Editor, React, Web Components, SuperSplat, SplatTransform and PCUI. New projects also ship PlayCanvas Skills, which give AI coding agents agent-oriented development and verification workflows. Together this is first-party documentation corroborated by independent runtime probes, covering every element of the story.
